name: NeRF-RCNN
definition: A network that takes a pre-trained NeRF as input and outputs 3D Axis-Aligned Bounding Boxes (AABB), class labels, and discrete 3D masks of detected objects.
summary: NeRF-RCNN is a 3D instance segmentation model that refines coarse proposals into precise bounding boxes and discrete masks, unlike Semantic-NeRF which only produces semantic labels.
